question: What is the meaning of product certification and labels in relation to health and safety aspects?
description: Product certification and labels in relation to health and safety aspects involve providing information on the health and safety aspects of a product. This includes data obtained from tests, practical experience, literature, Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS), and other sources to ensure that consumers and users are informed about potential hazards and risks associated with the product.
